chunks.head: get away from
chunks.note: get away from sth = 摆脱、逃避某事物；也可指从某地脱身离开。
chunks.ex_en: I just want to get away from all this noise.
chunks.ex_cn: 我只想摆脱这一切噪音。

chunks.head: feel sorry for
chunks.note: feel sorry for sb = 同情、可怜某人。注意此处 sorry 不是道歉的“对不起”。
chunks.ex_en: I feel sorry for the lost dog.
chunks.ex_cn: 我很同情那只走失的狗。

chunks.head: stand by
chunks.gloss: 支持；在困难时不离不弃
chunks.note: stand by sb = 在某人有难时支持、陪伴、不离弃。另有“待命、袖手旁观”等义。

literal.note_cn: stand 的过去式，此处非“站立”

chunks.ex_en: A true friend will stand by you in hard times.
chunks.ex_cn: 真正的朋友会在你困难时支持你。

chunks.head: out of luck
chunks.note: out of luck = 运气用尽、不走运。反义 in luck = 走运。
chunks.ex_en: We were out of luck—the shop had just closed.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们运气不好，商店刚关门。

chunks.head: loaf around
chunks.gloss: 游手好闲；无所事事地闲逛
chunks.note: loaf around = 无所事事地混日子、四处闲荡。

literal.note_cn: 作动词，指无所事事，非“面包”

chunks.ex_en: He loafs around all day instead of looking for a job.
chunks.ex_cn: 他整天游手好闲，也不去找工作。

chunks.head: hang about
chunks.note: hang about = 在某处闲荡、逗留（英式常说 hang about，美式多说 hang around），此处非“悬挂”。
chunks.ex_en: The kids hang about the park after school.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公园里闲逛。

chunks.head: clear away
chunks.note: clear away = 把障碍、疑难、雾气或餐具等清除、消除干净。
chunks.ex_en: The sun will soon clear away the fog.
chunks.ex_cn: 太阳很快会驱散雾气。

chunks.head: force oneself to do
chunks.note: force oneself to do sth = 强迫自己去做（不情愿的）事。
chunks.ex_en: She forced herself to get up early every day.
chunks.ex_cn: 她强迫自己每天早起。

chunks.head: keep one's ears open
chunks.note: keep one's ears open = 留神倾听、注意有没有消息。
chunks.ex_en: Keep your ears open for any news about the job.
chunks.ex_cn: 留心打听有没有那份工作的消息。

chunks.head: flock to
chunks.note: flock to = 大批人涌向某处。flock 原指鸟兽成群。

literal.note_cn: 原指鸟羊成群，喻人群蜂拥

chunks.ex_en: Fans flocked to the stadium for the final match.
chunks.ex_cn: 球迷蜂拥赶到球场看决赛。

chunks.head: file in
chunks.note: file in = 一个接一个排成队进入（反义 file out = 鱼贯而出）。此处 file 非“文件、锉刀”。
chunks.ex_en: The students filed in and sat down quietly.
chunks.ex_cn: 学生们鱼贯而入，安静坐下。

chunks.head: take one's place
chunks.note: take one's place = 到自己的位置上、就座、就位。
chunks.ex_en: The players took their places on the field.
chunks.ex_cn: 队员们在场上各就各位。

chunks.head: sneak away
chunks.note: sneak away = 悄悄地溜走、不让人察觉地离开。
chunks.ex_en: He tried to sneak away before the meeting ended.
chunks.ex_cn: 他想在会议结束前偷偷溜走。

chunks.head: change one's mind
chunks.note: change one's mind = 改变原来的决定或想法。
chunks.ex_en: I was going to buy it, but I changed my mind.
chunks.ex_cn: 我本来要买，可后来改变了主意。

chunks.head: under the influence of
chunks.note: under the influence of = 受…影响；单说 under the influence 常特指“醉酒/受药物作用”。本章即指酒力作用。
chunks.ex_en: He made that choice under the influence of his friends.
chunks.ex_cn: 他是在朋友的影响下做出那个决定的。

chunks.head: above suspicion
chunks.note: above suspicion = 好到不容怀疑、清白可信。above 此处表“超出（怀疑）之上”。
chunks.ex_en: The judge must be honest and above suspicion.
chunks.ex_cn: 法官必须诚实、清白无可怀疑。

chunks.head: to and fro
chunks.note: to and fro = 来来回回、往复移动。

literal.note_cn: 古旧词，几乎只用于此搭配

chunks.ex_en: The baby fell asleep as the cradle rocked to and fro.
chunks.ex_cn: 摇篮来回摆动，婴儿睡着了。

chunks.head: never mind
chunks.note: never mind = 别放在心上、不必费心（安慰别人或叫人别操心时用）。
chunks.ex_en: Never mind the mess—I'll clean it later.
chunks.ex_cn: 别管这乱糟糟的，我待会儿收拾。

chunks.head: speak up
chunks.note: speak up = 把声音提高一点；也可指“公开表态、仗义执言”。
chunks.ex_en: Could you speak up? I can't hear you.
chunks.ex_cn: 你能大声点吗？我听不见。

chunks.head: speak out
chunks.note: speak out = 把想法直率地说出来、公开表态。
chunks.ex_en: Don't be shy—speak out and tell us what you think.
chunks.ex_cn: 别害羞，大胆说出你的想法。

chunks.head: with bated breath
chunks.gloss: 屏息地；紧张急切地（等待）
chunks.note: with bated breath = 屏住呼吸地，形容紧张、急切地期待。

literal.note_cn: 古旧词，几乎只用于 bated breath

chunks.ex_en: We waited with bated breath for the results.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们屏息等待结果。

chunks.head: quick as lightning
chunks.note: quick as lightning = 快得像闪电，形容动作极快。
chunks.ex_en: Quick as lightning, the cat caught the mouse.
chunks.ex_cn: 猫飞快地抓住了老鼠。

chunks.head: give a start
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式（“gave a barely perceptible start”，中间插入形容词），故 card-only。give a start = 因惊吓而猛地一动、吓一跳。

literal.note_cn: 此处为名词“吓一跳”，非“开始”

chunks.ex_en: The loud knock gave me a start.
chunks.ex_cn: 那响亮的敲门声吓了我一跳。
